step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows content ingestion and enrichment workflow for Launchmetrics. The top block represents EC2 Spot instances handling data ingestion (from external posts/comments). Data and state management are routed to Amazon Kinesis and AWS SQS. From Kinesis and SQS, data flows down to a second block of EC2 Spot instances handling AI model enrichment. The enriched data is then saved into Aurora and OpenSearch, represented by a combined box decomposed into separate Aurora and OpenSearch nodes as per rule 4.
